mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_session (user_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at FROM user_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_session WHERE expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{batchSize}
